parameters.colliderPolicy: Include full authored furniture silhouettes and individual door jamb/handle/baseboard protrusions at player height; retain 0.25m capsule and actual-triangle validation
parameters.surfacePolicy: Physical capsule radius 0.25m with exact walkable-union exterior boundary distance and continuous path validation; no weakened walls, doors, furniture or floor edges

derivation.furnitureProxies: Generated alongside exact furniture geometry; independent actual-triangle verification required
derivation.closedDoorPolicy: All 12 doors start closed; permitted tour routes open their required doors through the shared animation/collision controller

stationResolutions.reason: Original inferred stop conflicts with actual door sweep; replacement remains in the same room within 0.5m and retains visual target. Fresh certification uses this candidate actual door geometry, capsule radius and modeled leaf thickness.

stationDoorClearance.method: Every complete closed-to-open sweep sampled at 2001 fractions; subtract maximum endpoint movement per interval as continuous Lipschitz bound. Actual current candidate doors and capsule dimensions; no endpoint-only acceptance.

inheritedProduction.method: Exact measured source payload inherited, candidate metadata and selected runtime URL updated. Not regenerated or browser acceptance transferred.

parkIntegrationInheritance.method: Exact local binary inheritance. Current host world frame and explicitly authorized room lifecycle derived separately. No historical browser, FPS or human approval transfer.

v6Derived.sourceUnitsNavigationStatus: Units 01-05 are visual source-layout units outside the inherited walkable surface. Their authored furniture has collision proxies, but no new doorway or walkable polygon is invented.
v6Derived.validation: reports/f12/navigation-validation.json; runtime algorithm, no browser claim
